data.summary: Link Shortener Security Hardening and Marketing Analytics Enhancements: 8 requirements (7 must), 4 assumptions, 3 open question(s). Blocking: Q1: Which threat intelligence engine or API (e.g., Google Safe Browsing, Cloudflare Radar, or AWS GuardDuty) should be integrated, and what is the required action when destination safety status is uncertain or the service is unreachable? (default: Use Google Safe Browsing API with a fail-open posture (allow redirect on external API timeout) cached with a 15-minute TTL, but fail-close for link creation.) | Q2: Should marketing insights include real-time dashboard UI access with user role management, or is an asynchronous export/API feed into an existing business intelligence tool (e.g., Looker, Mixpanel, Snowflake) sufficient? (default: Provide a RESTful analytics API and send click events to an existing customer data platform/warehouse; defer custom analytics UI to a subsequent milestone.)

data.comment:
Answers from the product owner (scripted for reproducible demos; in interactive mode you type your own):
- "Safer" means: only http/https targets; block localhost, private and cloud-metadata addresses (SSRF);
  reject targets on a configurable domain denylist (malware/phishing); links expire after 90 days by
  default, configurable per link; rate-limit link creation per client.
- "Better insights" means: per-link total clicks, clicks per UTC day for the last 30 days, and the top
  referrer domains. No personal data: do not store IP addresses or full user agents.
- This is a new service; no existing system to integrate with.
- Out of scope for now: user accounts, QR codes, geo-location.
